```

FAILED: [code=1] bin/test_nativert 
: && /opt/rh/gcc-toolset-13/root/usr/bin/c++ -fvisibility-inlines-hidden -DUSE_PTHREADPOOL -DNDEBUG -DUSE_KINETO -DLIBKINETO_NOCUPTI -DLIBKINETO_NOROCTRACER -DLIBKINETO_NOXPUPTI=ON -DUSE_PYTORCH_QNNPACK -DAT_BUILD_ARM_VEC256_WITH_SLEEF -DUSE_XNNPACK -DSYMBOLICATE_MOBILE_DEBUG_HANDLE -O2 -fPIC -DC10_NODEPRECATED -Wall -Wextra -Werror=return-type -Werror=non-virtual-dtor -Werror=range-loop-construct -Werror=bool-operation -Wnarrowing -Wno-missing-field-initializers -Wno-unknown-pragmas -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-strict-overflow -Wno-strict-aliasing -Wno-stringop-overflow -Wsuggest-override -Wno-psabi -Wno-error=old-style-cast -faligned-new -Wno-maybe-uninitialized -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math -Werror=format -Wno-dangling-reference -Wno-error=dangling-reference -Wno-stringop-overflow -DHAVE_SVE_CPU_DEFINITION -DHAVE_SVE256_CPU_DEFINITION -DHAVE_ARM_BF16_CPU_DEFINITION -O3 -DNDEBUG -DNDEBUG -rdynamic -Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x10000 -Wl,--no-as-needed test_nativert ... <REDACTED>  -Wl,--no-as-needed,"/builds/software/machine-learning/infra-frameworks/workspaces/robhar02/pytorch/build/lib/libtorch_cpu.so" -Wl,--as-needed  lib/libprotobuf.a  lib/libc10.so  lib/libgtest.a  -pthread && /opt/_internal/cpython-3.10.18/lib/python3.10/site-packages/cmake/data/bin/cmake -E __run_co_compile --lwyu="ldd;-u;-r" --source=bin/test_nativert && :
/opt/rh/gcc-toolset-13/root/usr/libexec/gcc/aarch64-redhat-linux/13/ld: test_nativert/CMakeFiles/test_nativert.dir/__/__/__/torch/nativert/executor/triton/CpuTritonKernelManager.cpp.o: undefined reference to symbol 'dlsym@@GLIBC_2.17'

collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

Error:
`torch/nativert/executor/triton/CpuTritonKernelManager.cpp.o: undefined reference to symbol 'dlsym@@GLIBC_2.17'`

I'm working on enabling AArch64 in ./.ci/manylinux/build.sh https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/160079 and i've run into this error when testing the build. Note - the build passes whene BUILD_TEST=OFF.

Looks like this is the originator of the erorr -  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/162217

### Versions

```
tag: trunk/be3b8d2ec94d36219c20fc4153f846e97a7ee39b
cpu: aarch64
```
